switched_because: User selected Qwen2.5-Coder to preserve the SWE-Gym model-family baseline and reduce simultaneous changes. No claim that Qwen3 is weaker is made.
SWE-Gym demonstrated teacher-success-trajectory SFT on Qwen2.5-Coder. Its 20.6% Verified result was the 32B teacher-SFT arm, not a 7B result or a demonstrated GRPO gain.
The pinned template supports tool schemas; trajectory function.arguments must be deserialized before rendering.
Existing weights may be reused only after matching pinned configuration, all required shards, and upstream content hashes.
decision.explicitly_not_claimed: No model capability gain or GRPO benefit has been established for route v2. Raw base success is not a necessary precondition for SFT; the policy entering GRPO needs useful reward variation.
decision.what_this_costs: Every route-v1 Qwen2.5 number is from the old framework and old tool protocol, so none of it may be compared with route-v2 numbers. The base run has to be redone on the new scaffold regardless, which is work this plan already included.

recorded_alternative.why_kept: Its template and tool contract are pinned at zero ongoing cost, so revisiting the choice later does not mean re-deriving them. It is NOT run in this round.
recorded_alternative.thinking_mode: non-thinking, if it is ever used: the template emits an empty <think></think> block when enable_thinking is false

pipeline_constraint_this_creates.statement: The SFT pipeline MUST deserialize tool_calls[].function.arguments before rendering.
pipeline_constraint_this_creates.why: The mainline template has no `is string` guard, so it runs arguments through `tojson` unconditionally. Trajectory datasets store arguments as a JSON string, so rendering them as-is produces a double-encoded call.
pipeline_constraint_this_creates.evidence: scripts/preflight_chat_template.py, scenario 4, reports this as a WARN on the mainline template and pins it with tests/test_preflight_chat_template.py::test_the_mainline_template_double_encodes_string_arguments
pipeline_constraint_this_creates.not_a_defect: The template is fine. The dataset card's own filter_and_deserialize helper does this deserialization, so the requirement is documented upstream rather than invented here.

not_preinstalled.statement: Neither model is guaranteed to be present. A clone of the old instance is expected to carry Qwen2.5-Coder snapshots, but that is unverified until the inventory runs; if it is absent, the weights must be downloaded.
not_preinstalled.download_path: HF_ENDPOINT=https://hf-mirror.com; huggingface.co is unreachable from the workstation and the worker, and the mirror itself drops connections intermittently, so scripts/gpu/fetch_model.sh retries and has a curl-only fallback.

unverified: that the clone carries Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct weights
the actual base resolve rate of either model on the frozen development split - this is what would justify the choice with data, and it has not been measured
that hf-mirror.com is reachable from the AutoDL box
